description: COMPANIES (accounts) from the brand's OWN HubSpot CRM, newest first: name, domain, website, LinkedIn company page, industry, employees, annual revenue, lifecycle stage, lead status, country/city, owner (rep name), original source + drill-downs, associated contacts and deals, total revenue — plus a de-duplicated `domains` list, which is what LinkedIn company targeting and account-based (ABM) audiences are built from. search matches name / domain / website / phone; filters lifecycleStage (e.g. customer, opportunity, salesqualifiedlead), industry (HubSpot's internal value, e.g. COMPUTER_SOFTWARE), hubspotOwnerId, createdSince (YYYY-MM-DD). Read-only, free. Needs HubSpot connected.
